declaration.argument: Only how seven integer columns of the executions, logs and traces files are encoded on disk changes: dictionary off and DELTA_BINARY_PACKED for run_id, seq_num, step, unique_id, trace_id, schedulable_count and causal_operation_id, statistics kept. The writer threads read nothing the search uses, and no value, row, order, draw or container the explorer reads changes. One-thread identity on VR (3,008 runs) against the baseline binary: runs, executions, logs and traces identical both ways through DuckDB, traceanalyzer output identical apart from clock fields, porcupine verdict identical, spur debug combined byte-identical for a run with a crash and recovery, same stall_cap_runs.csv hash, utilization and campaign leaves differing only in clocks; parquet metadata shows the 13 switched chunks delta-encoded without dictionary pages and with min/max.
